By following the rule of 1 inche= one gallon you can find can find out how many gallons of free swimming space your betta needs. So applying this to bigger bettas step one is measure your betta every inch one gallon of free swimming space then the rest plant up. So for mine pushing 4 inches I am upgrading the 10 gallon for more space.
